documentation.file_docstring:
Bridge between legacy GovernancePolicy and declarative PolicyDocument.

Provides bidirectional conversion so existing code continues to work while
new code can use the declarative policy format.
inline_comments: Allowed tools rule (if a tool is not in the allowed list, deny)
member_docstrings: governance_to_document: Convert an existing GovernancePolicy to a declarative PolicyDocument.
document_to_governance: Convert a declarative PolicyDocument back to a GovernancePolicy.
